caption:
Quick myth-buster. 🧠

Hard inquiries stop counting toward your FICO score after 12 months, even though they stay on your report for 2 years.

Did you know that?

instagram.first_comment: Did you know? Tell us below. @creditscoretruths 🧠

card.headline: Hard inquiries stop hurting FICO after 12 months.
card.sub: They stay on your report 2 years.
